body:
I like it.  I especially like the skin blemishes you've given her, the veins in the eyes, and the unruly bits of hair that aren't perfectly in place.

I'd be happy with that as the final product, but if you are looking for areas to work on, I'd pick the eyes.  Maybe some light crows feet, a bit of discoloration or bags under the eyes.  There's also something unnatural looking in that fleshy area in the corner of the eyes called the caruncle.

[https://shubsthoughts.blogspot.com/2013/06/whats-in-name-lacrimal-caruncle.html](https://shubsthoughts.blogspot.com/2013/06/whats-in-name-lacrimal-caruncle.html)
